groups.sentence: Instructors do not prohibit AI in their courses.
Instructors help students learn to use AI responsibly instead of trying to ban it.
Banning AI harms students by making work harder and cutting them off from useful technologies.
AI undermines the reliability of take-home work and other assessments of student learning.
Proctoring may reduce AI use in assessments.
AI use in student work is hard or impossible to detect or prove, and no detection method is foolproof.
Detecting AI use will become harder as AI tools improve and as students learn to evade detectors.
AI use cannot be fully prevented, and bans or prohibitions are impractical and hard to enforce.
AI is already widely used and embedded in everyday tools, so students will use it regardless.
